open_points.subject: record_change
open_points.text: record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] A content record is written with its order-free lists sorted, never in the order a caller submitted them: ports by direction and then by name, flow nodes by node_id, flow edges by to_node, then to_port, then from_node, then from_port, flow constants by to_node and then to_port, each compared as text by Unicode code point, so equal content submitted in another order is the same record with the same lists; an OperationBinding writes its inputs and its outputs, each a list of ports of one direction, each sorted by name compared the same way, the name order A08 checks a proposal's ports in; every read returns those lists in that order, and every other list, and every JSON value, keeps its order.
open_points.other_text: - OperationBinding fields (exact, no others exist): accepted_at: KernelInstant | None, accepted_by: Actor | None, binding_id: str, effect_class: EffectClass, idempotency_key_fields: tuple[str, ...], inputs: tuple[Port, ...], operation_name: str, outputs: tuple[Port, ...], proposed_at: KernelInstant, proposed_by: Actor, record_digest: str, service_id: str, status: BindingStatus
open_points.question: Must the note say that inputs and outputs are tuples of ports, or must the OperationBinding model fields change from tuple[Port, ...] to lists?
